subject: Request: Pilot extension — SDK dependency mismatch blocking integration
messages:
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@cloudvantage.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@cloudvantage.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot blocked by SDK dependency mismatch — ask for extension

Hi Priya,

Quick note from our side — we hit a blocker in the integration test this morning. Our internal SDK (used across services) recently flipped the gRPC dependency from 1.45.0 to 1.50.2 as part of a security patch. That change surfaces an incompatibility in the way Redwood’s client handles metadata propagation for service-to-service auth (we’re seeing token drops on long-poll requests).

Engineering estimate is ~10 business days to backport a fix and validate end-to-end. Our PoC window expires next Tuesday (2028-09-17) and we risk losing momentum if the environment is shut off during the fix.

Can you approve a 2-week pilot extension and a small sandbox credit top-up so our engineers can finish tests and run a full performance sweep? I attached the failing log and our proposed integration plan.

Attachments: build-error.log (text), integration-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Harper
Head of Integrations, CloudVantage
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@cloudvantage.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by SDK dependency mismatch — ask for extension

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick heads-up and for sending the logs.

We can absolutely support you through this. I’ve looped in Ben (AE) for the commercial approval and David (engineering) to scope the technical mitigation and confirm the runtime compatibility steps. Marissa from CS is on standby for onboarding/ops once you’re green.

Ben — would provisioning a 2-week extension with a 50k-token sandbox top-up be within the playbook? If not, what’s an acceptable make-good we can offer quickly?

David — any quick wins on our side that could reduce the engineering turnaround time (patch or config-level workaround)?

I’ll hold the current pilot active while we sort this out.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Alex Harper <alex.harper@cloudvantage.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 09:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by SDK dependency mismatch — ask for extension

Thanks Priya — Alex, sorry you ran into this. On a commercial side we have two fast options:

- Option A (self-serve): 14-day pilot extension + 40k-token sandbox credit (approved by AE program).
- Option B (escalation): 21-day extension + 80k-token credit, requires Sales Ops sign-off (can be done same day if legal approves a short amendment).

Given the described work (10 business days), Option B is safer, but Option A gets you across the line quickly while engineering implements the fix. If you confirm which you prefer I’ll send the amendment link (DocuSign) and apply the token top-up immediately.

Marissa — once Alex confirms, can you schedule a short validation run with our DevRel so we can reduce back-and-forth?

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Alex Harper <alex.harper@cloudvantage.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 14:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by SDK dependency mismatch — technical update

Alex — quick technical note: thanks for the error dump. This looks like a metadata propagation regression exposed by gRPC behavior changes between 1.45 and 1.50. We see two viable short-term paths:

1) Config workaround (recommended): adjust client-side call options to explicitly forward metadata for long-poll RPCs. This is a small change (~1–2 dev days) and can be validated against the sandbox.

2) Runtime patch: make a minor change in our SDK client to tolerate the new gRPC behavior. That’s ~5–7 dev days plus testing.

If CloudVantage can run a quick validation (I can provide a diff and test harness), we should be able to confirm the workaround in 48 hours.

I’ll post the patch PR to our internal staging and share instructions for your DevOps team to run the harness.

— David
David Kim
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime Integrations, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@cloudvantage.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by SDK dependency mismatch — approval and next steps

Alex — thanks for the quick coordination and David for the clear options.

CloudVantage: because the team prefers not to rework the SDK immediately, you indicated you want the fastest route to validation — please confirm you want Option A (14 days + 40k tokens) to keep momentum and run David’s 48-hour validation harness. If you’d rather lock in Option B we can push the larger amendment through Sales Ops today.

Once you confirm Option A I’ll:
- Apply a 14-day extension and 40k-token top-up within 2 hours.
- Send a DocuSign amendment for the pilot extension (quick signature only).
- Schedule a 30-minute validation session with Marissa and David tomorrow.

Please reply with one-line confirmation (Option A / Option B).

Thanks,
— Priya
